2610.13617.title: Training User Simulators with Latent Intrinsic Feedback
2610.13617.paper_summary: User simulators are gaining attention as environments to train LLM assistants that can better cope with the nuances of multi-turn conversations with real users. Prior work on user simulation has emphasized generating realistic user utterances, leaving unexplored their potential as a source of direct feedback on the assistant's responses. Such evaluation signals may not be explicitly communicated in language, but can instead reside in the latent reasoning of users. In this work, we introduce user simulators with intrinsic feedback, namely, models equipped with latent evaluation states: internal thoughts, reactions, and scalar ratings that evaluate the assistant from a first-person user perspective at each conversation turn. We train LLM-based simulators using interaction logs between real users and assistants and demonstrate that intrinsic feedback improves simulation realism and critiquing behaviors versus prompted simulator baselines, while also providing turn-level evaluations that existing fine-tuned simulators lack. Further, evaluations generated by our trained simulators correlate better with human judgments than those of prompted simulators of the same size. Lastly, our experiments reveal that simulators with intrinsic feedback provide effective reward signals for multi-turn RL training, matching setups that rely on external judge LLMs for rewards while cutting RL compute by more than half.
2610.13617.paper_summary_zh: 使用者模擬器正受到關注，作為訓練大型語言模型助手的環境，能更好地應對與真實使用者進行多輪對話的細微差別。先前的使用者模擬工作強調生成真實的使用者發言，卻未探討它們作為助手回應直接反饋來源的潛力。這種評估信號可能並未以語言明確傳達，而是可能存在於使用者的潛在推理中。在這項工作中，我們引入了具有內在反饋的使用者模擬器，即配備潛在評估狀態的模型：內部思考、反應和標量評分，這些評分從第一人稱使用者的角度在每個對話輪次中評估助手。我們使用真實使用者和助手之間的互動日誌訓練基於大型語言模型的模擬器，並展示內在反饋在模擬現實性和批評行為方面相較於提示模擬器基準的改進，同時提供現有微調模擬器所缺乏的輪次級評估。此外，我們訓練的模擬器生成的評估與人類判斷的相關性優於同樣大小的提示模擬器。最後，我們的實驗顯示，具有內在反饋的模擬器為多輪強化學習訓練提供了有效的獎勵信號，與依賴外部評審大型語言模型獲得獎勵的設置相匹配，同時將強化學習計算量減少了一半以上。
